verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for a remote-desktop SaaS with a REST API and management console, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a pull-based REST API (list clients, retrieve session history, close sessions) and a CLI, with no documented registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for event subscription. Polling the REST API is an adjacent building block, not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
